name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A styled data table on ui-sdk-table-vue, with UI SDK components for every control: search, column filters, column menu, export, selection and pages.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts" generic="Row">
import {
	ArrowDownIcon,
	ArrowUpIcon,
	CheckIcon,
	ChevronsUpDownIcon,
	MinusIcon,
	XIcon,
} from '@lucide/vue'
import { Button } from '@ui-sdk/vue/button'
import {
	cellValue,
	createTableController,
	isEmptyFilter,
	isNumericFormat,
	Table,
	toText,
	type CellAttrsContext,
	type ColumnDef,
	type GroupSlotProps,
	type RowAttrsContext,
	type TableInstance,
	type TableView,
} from 'ui-sdk-table-vue'
import {
	computed,
	onBeforeUnmount,
	onMounted,
	provide,
	shallowRef,
	useTemplateRef,
	watch,
} from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import DataTableCheckbox from './DataTableCheckbox.vue'
import DataTableChevron from './DataTableChevron.vue'
import {
	buttonClass,
	focusInsetClass,
	indentClass,
	MAX_INDENT,
	skeletonClass,
} from './DataTableClasses'
import DataTableEmpty from './DataTableEmpty.vue'
import DataTableExpandAll from './DataTableExpandAll.vue'
import DataTableLink from './DataTableLink.vue'
import DataTablePagination from './DataTablePagination.vue'
import DataTableSelectAll from './DataTableSelectAll.vue'
import DataTableToolbar from './DataTableToolbar.vue'
import { resolveMessages, type DataTableExportFormat } from './messages'
import {
	DATA_TABLE_CONTEXT,
	EXPAND_COLUMN,
	isOwnColumn,
	SELECT_COLUMN,
	VIEW_KEYS,
	type DataTableColumn,
	type DataTableColumnMeta,
	type DataTableEmits,
	type DataTableProps,
	type DataTableSlots,
} from './types'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<DataTableProps<Row>>(), {
	pageSizes: () => [10, 25, 50, 100],
	width: 'full',
	scroll: 'self',
	skeletonRows: 3,
	// An option of the table that is not set must reach the table as "not
	// set", so the table keeps its own default. Vue reads a boolean that is
	// not set as false.
	sortChildren: undefined,
	resizable: undefined,
	reorderable: undefined,
	rowWindow: undefined,
	stickyHeader: undefined,
	stickyFooter: undefined,
	editable: undefined,
	cellSelection: undefined,
	manualSort: undefined,
	manualFilter: undefined,
	manualPage: undefined,
	loading: undefined,
})

const emit = defineEmits<DataTableEmits<Row>>()
const slots = defineSlots<DataTableSlots<Row>>()

const controller = props.controller ?? createTableController()
const messages = computed(() => resolveMessages(props.messages))
const label = computed(() => props.label ?? '')

// What the controls show comes from the table, and the table is not
// reactive. So the view is read again after each change that a control shows.
const view = shallowRef<TableView>()
const refresh = () => {
	view.value = controller.getView()
}

// A search, a filter, a sort and a page change what the table shows, and a
// person who does not see the table hears of it here. The text comes after a
// pause, once, so a fast typist hears the count of the last letter only.
const status = shallowRef('')
const ANNOUNCED: readonly string[] = ['filter', 'groupBy', 'sort', 'page']
const PAUSE = 500
const unsaid = new Set<string>()
let pause: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined

function note(changed: readonly string[]) {
	for (const key of changed) if (ANNOUNCED.includes(key)) unsaid.add(key)
	if (!unsaid.size) return
	// An empty region first: the same text as the last time is said again.
	status.value = ''
	clearTimeout(pause)
	pause = setTimeout(announce, PAUSE)
}

function announce() {
	const now = view.value
	// Rows that are on their way have no count yet. Their arrival is a change, and that starts the pause again.
	if (!now || now.loading) return
	const texts = messages.value
	if (unsaid.has('filter') || unsaid.has('groupBy')) {
		status.value = texts.rowsFound({
			total: now.rowCount,
			unit: now.pageUnit,
			rows: now.dataRowCount,
		})
	} else if (unsaid.has('sort')) {
		const name = (id: string) => now.columns.find((column) => column.id === id)?.header ?? id
		status.value = texts.sortedBy({
			sort: now.sort.map((rule) => ({ column: name(rule.id), desc: rule.desc ?? false })),
		})
	} else {
		status.value = now.lastPageKnown
			? texts.pageOf({ page: now.page, pageCount: now.pageCount })
			: texts.pageNumber({ page: now.page })
	}
	unsaid.clear()
}

let stop: (() => void) | undefined
onMounted(() => {
	if (import.meta.env.DEV && !props.label) {
		console.warn(
			'[DataTable] The table has no accessible name. Pass `label`: assistive technology and an agent find the table by it, and tell its controls from those of another table.',
		)
	}
	// The ids of groups come from the rows, so the table opens them itself.
	// It happens before the first paint: nobody sees the closed groups.
	if (props.defaultExpanded === 'all' && !props.expanded) controller.expandAll()
	refresh()
	stop = controller.subscribe((changed) => {
		if (!changed.some((key) => VIEW_KEYS.includes(key))) return
		refresh()
		note(changed)
	})
})
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	stop?.()
	clearTimeout(pause)
})
// An option can change what a control shows without a change of state.
watch(() => [props.selection, props.canSelect, props.locale], refresh, { flush: 'post' })

// `pagination` can come and go while the table is on the page. The pages are
// state of the table, so the table gets them, or loses them, here.
watch(
	() => props.pagination,
	(on) => {
		const size = view.value?.pageSize
		if (!view.value) return
		if (on && size === undefined) controller.setPageSize(props.pageSizes[0] ?? 10)
		else if (!on && size !== undefined) controller.setPageSize(null)
	},
)

const selected = computed<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => new Set(view.value?.selected))
const filterCount = computed(
	() =>
		Object.values(view.value?.filter.columns ?? {}).filter((value) => !isEmptyFilter(value)).length,
)

/** The kind of file of an export that failed, while its message shows. */
const failedExport = shallowRef<DataTableExportFormat>()

provide(DATA_TABLE_CONTEXT, {
	controller,
	view,
	messages,
	label,
	selected,
	filterCount,
	exportStarted: () => {
		failedExport.value = undefined
	},
	exportFailed: (error, format) => {
		failedExport.value = format
		emit('exportError', error, { format })
	},
})

const exportOptions = computed(() =>
	props.export === true ? {} : props.export ? props.export : undefined,
)
const hasToolbar = computed(
	() =>
		props.search ||
		props.columnFilters ||
		props.columnMenu ||
		exportOptions.value !== undefined ||
		!!slots.toolbar,
)

const hasExpandColumn = computed(() => !!props.hasDetail || !!props.getChildren)

// The two columns of the styled table hold a control and no value: they take
// no part in the search, a filter, an export or the list of columns. They
// lead the table: first under any column order, and at the start edge beside
// a column that is pinned there. No order and no pin of the caller holds them.
const own = (id: string, width: number): ColumnDef<Row> => ({
	id,
	lead: true,
	header: '',
	value: () => undefined,
	width,
	sortable: false,
	searchable: false,
	groupable: false,
	hideable: false,
	resizable: false,
	reorderable: false,
	editable: false,
	exportable: false,
})

const ownIds = computed(() => [
	...(props.selection ? [SELECT_COLUMN] : []),
	...(hasExpandColumn.value ? [EXPAND_COLUMN] : []),
])

const columns = computed<readonly ColumnDef<Row>[]>(() => [
	...ownIds.value.map((id) => own(id, 40)),
	...(props.columns ?? []),
])

/** The columns in view. A part that reads the whole view renders for each change; this changes with the columns only. */
const visibleColumns = computed(() => view.value?.visibleColumns ?? [])

/** The first column of the caller that holds cells. Its text names a row for a checkbox or a button. */
const nameColumn = computed(() => {
	let found: DataTableColumn<Row> | undefined = props.columns?.[0]
	while (found?.columns?.length) found = found.columns[0]
	return found
})
const rowName = (row: Row) => {
	const column = nameColumn.value
	return column ? toText(cellValue(row, column)) : ''
}

/** The options and the state of the caller, as the table takes them. */
const tableProps = computed<TableInstance<Row>['$props']>(() => ({
	rows: props.rows,
	columns: columns.value,
	getRowId: props.getRowId,
	getChildren: props.getChildren,
	locale: props.locale,
	searchMode: props.searchMode,
	fuzzyThreshold: props.fuzzyThreshold,
	sortChildren: props.sortChildren,
	canGroup: props.canGroup,
	selection: props.selection,
	canSelect: props.canSelect,
	resizable: props.resizable,
	reorderable: props.reorderable,
	columnMinWidth: props.columnMinWidth,
	columnMaxWidth: props.columnMaxWidth,
	messages: messages.value,
	controller,
	rowWindow: props.rowWindow,
	rowHeight: props.rowHeight,
	estimatedRowHeight: props.estimatedRowHeight,
	overscan: props.overscan,
	stickyHeader: props.stickyHeader,
	stickyFooter: props.stickyFooter,
	hasDetail: props.hasDetail,
	editable: props.editable,
	cellSelection: props.cellSelection,
	manualSort: props.manualSort,
	manualFilter: props.manualFilter,
	facets: props.facets,
	manualPage: props.manualPage,
	rowCount: props.rowCount,
	loading: props.loading,
	sort: props.sort,
	defaultSort: props.defaultSort,
	filter: props.filter,
	defaultFilter: props.defaultFilter,
	groupBy: props.groupBy,
	defaultGroupBy: props.defaultGroupBy,
	page: props.page,
	// With `pagination` and no page of the caller, the table starts on its first page.
	defaultPage:
		props.defaultPage ??
		(props.pagination && !props.page ? { page: 1, pageSize: props.pageSizes[0] ?? 10 } : undefined),
	expanded: props.expanded,
	defaultExpanded: props.defaultExpanded === 'all' ? undefined : props.defaultExpanded,
	selected: props.selected,
	defaultSelected: props.defaultSelected,
	columnVisibility: props.columnVisibility,
	defaultColumnVisibility: props.defaultColumnVisibility,
	columnOrder: props.columnOrder,
	defaultColumnOrder: props.defaultColumnOrder,
	columnWidths: props.columnWidths,
	defaultColumnWidths: props.defaultColumnWidths,
	columnPinning: props.columnPinning,
	defaultColumnPinning: props.defaultColumnPinning,
	rowPinning: props.rowPinning,
	defaultRowPinning: props.defaultRowPinning,
	cellRange: props.cellRange,
	defaultCellRange: props.defaultCellRange,
}))

// Every event of the table goes on to the caller under its own name. The
// table sends the change first and the `update:` after it, and not at all
// when a listener cancels the change; that order stays.
const listeners: TableInstance<Row>['$props'] = {
	'onUpdate:sort': (value) => emit('update:sort', value),
	'onUpdate:filter': (value) => emit('update:filter', value),
	'onUpdate:groupBy': (value) => emit('update:groupBy', value),
	'onUpdate:page': (value) => emit('update:page', value),
	'onUpdate:expanded': (value) => emit('update:expanded', value),
	'onUpdate:selected': (value) => emit('update:selected', value),
	'onUpdate:columnVisibility': (value) => emit('update:columnVisibility', value),
	'onUpdate:columnOrder': (value) => emit('update:columnOrder', value),
	'onUpdate:columnWidths': (value) => emit('update:columnWidths', value),
	'onUpdate:columnPinning': (value) => emit('update:columnPinning', value),
	'onUpdate:rowPinning': (value) => emit('update:rowPinning', value),
	'onUpdate:cellRange': (value) => emit('update:cellRange', value),
	onSortChange: (value, details) => emit('sortChange', value, details),
	onFilterChange: (value, details) => emit('filterChange', value, details),
	onGroupByChange: (value, details) => emit('groupByChange', value, details),
	onPageChange: (value, details) => emit('pageChange', value, details),
	onExpandedChange: (value, details) => emit('expandedChange', value, details),
	onSelectedChange: (value, details) => emit('selectedChange', value, details),
	onColumnVisibilityChange: (value, details) => emit('columnVisibilityChange', value, details),
	onColumnOrderChange: (value, details) => emit('columnOrderChange', value, details),
	onColumnWidthsChange: (value, details) => emit('columnWidthsChange', value, details),
	onColumnWidthsCommit: (value, details) => emit('columnWidthsCommit', value, details),
	onColumnPinningChange: (value, details) => emit('columnPinningChange', value, details),
	onRowPinningChange: (value, details) => emit('rowPinningChange', value, details),
	onCellRangeChange: (value, details) => emit('cellRangeChange', value, details),
	onCellRangeCommit: (value, details) => emit('cellRangeCommit', value, details),
	onCellEdit: (edits, details) => emit('cellEdit', edits, details),
}

const metaOf = (column: ColumnDef<Row>) => (column.meta ?? {}) as DataTableColumnMeta<Row>

const ALIGN = { start: 'text-start', center: 'text-center', end: 'text-end' } as const

function alignOf(column: ColumnDef<Row>, leaf = true) {
	const align =
		metaOf(column).align ??
		(leaf && column.format && isNumericFormat(column.format) ? 'end' : 'start')
	return ALIGN[align]
}

// A row that stays in view has cells that stick, because a row of a table
// cannot. Such a cell is opaque: the rows under it must not show through.
const stuck =
	'in-data-sticky:sticky in-data-sticky:z-20 in-data-sticky:bg-background in-data-[sticky=top]:top-(--table-sticky-offset) in-data-[sticky=bottom]:bottom-(--table-sticky-offset)'
// A pinned cell is opaque too.
const pinned =
	'data-pinned:sticky data-pinned:z-10 data-pinned:bg-background data-[pinned=start]:start-(--table-pin-offset) data-[pinned=end]:end-(--table-pin-offset) in-data-sticky:data-pinned:z-30'
// An opaque cell hides the fill of its row, so it paints the tint of the row
// itself, as a layer of one colour over its own fill. The colour is the
// `from` stop of a gradient that ends where it starts. The table sets the
// stop for a hovered and for a selected row; a caller sets it for a tint of
// its own with a class for the cells of the row, such as `*:from-warning/15`.
const tinted =
	'from-100% in-data-sticky:bg-linear-to-b data-pinned:bg-linear-to-b group-hover/row:from-muted/50 group-aria-selected/row:from-muted'
const sized = 'in-data-sized:overflow-hidden in-data-sized:text-ellipsis'
// A cell that gets focus scrolls into view, and it must stop beside the sticky rows and the pinned columns, not under them.
const beside =
	'scroll-mt-(--table-sticky-top-size) scroll-mb-(--table-sticky-bottom-size) scroll-ms-(--table-pin-start-size) scroll-me-(--table-pin-end-size) in-data-sticky:scroll-my-0 data-pinned:scroll-mx-0'

const headClass = cn(
	'relative h-10 border-b border-border px-2 align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-foreground',
	'data-moving:bg-accent data-grabbed:z-40 data-grabbed:translate-x-(--drag-x)',
	// The handle that resizes a column is a thin bar at the end edge of its header.
	// UI SDK gives it its cursor and its touch action.
	'[&_[data-slot=table-resizer]]:absolute [&_[data-slot=table-resizer]]:inset-y-0 [&_[data-slot=table-resizer]]:end-0 [&_[data-slot=table-resizer]]:w-1.5 [&_[data-slot=table-resizer]]:outline-none [&_[data-slot=table-resizer]:is(:hover,:focus-visible,[data-dragging])]:bg-ring',
	stuck,
	pinned,
	sized,
	beside,
	focusInsetClass,
)

const cellClass = cn(
	'border-b border-border p-2 align-middle whitespace-nowrap',
	// A range of cells has a tint, as a layer like the tint of a row, so a pinned cell stays opaque under it.
	'data-selected:bg-linear-to-b data-selected:from-primary/10',
	// The editor of a cell takes the place of its text.
	'data-editing:relative data-editing:overflow-visible data-editing:p-0',
	// The editor fills its cell and asks for no width of its own: with a width
	// of its own, a column of a table without fixed widths would grow while a
	// cell of it is open.
	'[&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:h-9 [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:w-0 [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:min-w-full [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:bg-background [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:px-2 [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:text-sm [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:outline-2 [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:-outline-offset-2 [&_[data-slot=table-editor]]:outline-ring [&_[data-slot=table-editor][aria-invalid=true]]:outline-destructive',
	'[&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:absolute [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:start-0 [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:top-full [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:z-40 [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:rounded-sm [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:bg-destructive [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:px-2 [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:py-1 [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:text-xs [&_[data-slot=table-edit-error]]:text-destructive-foreground',
	stuck,
	pinned,
	tinted,
	sized,
	beside,
	focusInsetClass,
)

const footClass = cn(
	'border-t border-border p-2 align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap',
	stuck,
	pinned,
	sized,
	beside,
	focusInsetClass,
)

const control = 'w-10 px-2 text-start'

// These two functions stay the same for the life of the table: a new
// function would render every row again. They read the props when the table
// renders, so a new class of the caller still arrives.
function rowAttrs(context: RowAttrsContext<Row>) {
	if (context.kind === 'row') {
		const custom =
			typeof props.rowClass === 'function'
				? props.rowClass(context.row, context.index)
				: props.rowClass
		return {
			class: cn(
				// `group/row` lets a cell that is opaque follow the hover and the selection of its row.
				'group/row transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 data-selected:bg-muted in-data-row-window:h-(--table-row-height)',
				custom,
			),
		}
	}
	if (context.kind === 'group') {
		return {
			class: cn(
				'bg-muted/30 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 in-data-row-window:h-(--table-row-height)',
				typeof props.rowClass === 'function' ? undefined : props.rowClass,
			),
		}
	}
	if (context.kind === 'detail') return { class: 'bg-muted/30' }
	return undefined
}

function cellAttrs(context: CellAttrsContext<Row>) {
	if (context.kind === 'header') {
		const column = context.column
		if (isOwnColumn(column.id)) return { class: cn(headClass, control) }
		return {
			class: cn(
				headClass,
				alignOf(column, context.leaf),
				props.headerClass,
				metaOf(column).headerClass,
			),
		}
	}
	if (context.kind === 'cell') {
		const column = context.column
		if (isOwnColumn(column.id)) return { class: cn(cellClass, control) }
		const meta = metaOf(column)
		return {
			class: cn(
				cellClass,
				alignOf(column),
				meta.wrap && 'whitespace-normal',
				props.cellClass,
				typeof meta.class === 'function' ? meta.class(context.value, context.row) : meta.class,
			),
		}
	}
	if (context.kind === 'foot') {
		return {
			class: cn(footClass, isOwnColumn(context.column.id) ? control : alignOf(context.column)),
		}
	}
	if (context.kind === 'detail') return { class: cn(cellClass, 'whitespace-normal') }
	if (context.kind === 'empty') {
		return { class: cn(cellClass, 'whitespace-normal', props.loading && 'p-0') }
	}
	return { class: cellClass }
}

// The last row of the body has no line: the frame, or the footer, draws it.
const sectionAttrs = { body: { class: '[&>tr:last-child>td]:border-b-0' } }

const frameClass = computed(() =>
	cn(
		'relative rounded-md border border-border',
		// A frame that scrolls is as wide as its place, and the table scrolls
		// inside it. A frame that never scrolls grows with a table that is wider
		// than its place, and the page scrolls: a frame that cut the table off
		// would have to scroll, and then no row could stick to the page.
		props.scroll === 'page'
			? props.width === 'auto'
				? 'w-fit'
				: 'w-fit min-w-full'
			: ['overflow-auto', props.width === 'auto' ? 'w-fit max-w-full' : 'w-full'],
		props.wrapperClass,
	),
)

const tableClass = computed(() =>
	cn(
		// Lines belong to the cells, not to the rows: a cell that sticks keeps its line.
		'border-separate border-spacing-0 caption-bottom text-sm text-foreground',
		props.width === 'auto' ? 'w-auto' : 'w-full',
		// A column takes its width from its `col` element. With a width for
		// every column, the table is as wide as their sum.
		'[&_[data-slot=table-col]]:w-(--table-column-width) data-sized:w-(--table-width) data-sized:table-fixed',
		// A spacer stands in for the rows that the row window does not render.
		'[&_[data-slot=table-spacer]]:h-(--table-spacer-size)',
		// Rows that wait for newer ones stay in view and readable; the cursor says that the table is busy.
		'data-loading:[&>tbody]:cursor-progress data-cell-selection:[&>tbody]:select-none',
		props.tableClass,
	),
)

/** The ids of the rows of a group that can be selected. */
function groupIds(group: GroupSlotProps<Row>['group']) {
	const can = props.canSelect
	return group.leaves.flatMap((leaf) => (!can || can(leaf.row) ? [leaf.id] : []))
}

const totalColumns = (group: GroupSlotProps<Row>) =>
	visibleColumns.value.filter((column) => column.id in group.totalTexts)

const skeletonColumns = computed(() => visibleColumns.value.length || columns.value.length)

/** The editor slots of the caller. The table has its own text field for a column without one. */
const editorSlots = computed(() =>
	Object.keys(slots).filter(
		(name): name is 'editor' | `edit-${string}` => name === 'editor' || name.startsWith('edit-'),
	),
)

const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root')

// The button of the message leaves the page with the message. Focus goes to
// the control that the message is about, or the keyboard would start again
// from the top of the page.
function dismissExportError() {
	failedExport.value = undefined
	root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-export-trigger]')?.focus()
}

defineExpose({
	/** The methods of the table: `sortBy`, `setSearch`, `select` and the others. */
	controller,
})
</script>

<template>
	<div ref="root" data-slot="data-table" class="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
		<DataTableToolbar
			v-if="hasToolbar"
			:search="search"
			:column-filters="columnFilters"
			:column-menu="columnMenu"
			:export="exportOptions"
		>
			<template #default="toolbar">
				<slot name="toolbar" v-bind="toolbar" />
			</template>
		</DataTableToolbar>
		<div
			v-if="failedExport"
			role="alert"
			data-slot="data-table-alert"
			class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md border border-destructive px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground"
		>
			<span>{{ messages.exportFailed({ format: failedExport }) }}</span>
			<Button
				:aria-label="messages.dismiss()"
				:class="buttonClass('ghost', 'icon-xs')"
				@click="dismissExportError"
			>
				<XIcon aria-hidden="true" />
			</Button>
		</div>
		<div data-slot="data-table-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="sr-only">
			{{ status }}
		</div>
		<div data-slot="data-table-frame" :class="frameClass">
			<Table
				v-bind="{ ...tableProps, ...listeners }"
				:row-attrs="rowAttrs"
				:cell-attrs="cellAttrs"
				:section-attrs="sectionAttrs"
				:aria-label="label || undefined"
				:class="tableClass"
			>
				<template #header="header">
					<template v-if="header.column.id === SELECT_COLUMN">
						<DataTableSelectAll v-if="selection === 'multiple'" />
						<span v-else class="sr-only">{{ messages.selectionColumn() }}</span>
					</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChevronDownIcon, DownloadIcon } from '@lucide/vue'
import { Menu, MenuContent, MenuItem, MenuTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import type { ExportOptions } from 'ui-sdk-table-vue'
import { buttonClass, listContentClass, listItemClass } from './DataTableClasses'
import type { DataTableExportFormat } from './messages'
import { useDataTable } from './types'

const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		csv?: boolean
		xlsx?: boolean
		/** The name of the file, without its ending. */
		filename?: string | (() => string)
		options?: ExportOptions
	}>(),
	{ csv: true, xlsx: true, filename: 'export' },
)

const { controller, messages, label, exportStarted, exportFailed } = useDataTable()

// The writers load when a person asks for a file, so a page whose table has
// no export, or whose export nobody uses, does not carry them. The load can
// fail, and so can the data and the file: the person hears of each.
async function write(format: DataTableExportFormat) {
	exportStarted()
	try {
		const writers = await import('ui-sdk-table-vue/export')
		const name = typeof props.filename === 'function' ? props.filename() : props.filename
		const data = controller.exportData(props.options)
		if (format === 'csv') writers.downloadCsv(data, name)
		else await writers.downloadXlsx(data, name)
	} catch (error) {
		exportFailed(error, format)
	}
}
</script>

		<MenuTrigger
			data-export-trigger
			:aria-label="messages.exportLabel({ table: label })"
			:class="buttonClass('outline')"

			<ChevronDownIcon aria-hidden="true" class="text-muted-foreground" />

		<MenuContent align="end" :side-offset="4" :class="listContentClass">
			<MenuItem v-if="csv" value="csv" :class="listItemClass" @select="write('csv')">
				{{ messages.exportCsv() }}
			</MenuItem>
			<MenuItem v-if="xlsx" value="xlsx" :class="listItemClass" @select="write('xlsx')">
				{{ messages.exportXlsx() }}

import { computed } from 'vue'
import DataTableCheckbox from './DataTableCheckbox.vue'
import { useDataTable } from './types'

const props = defineProps<{
	/** The name of the checkbox. Without it, the checkbox is named for all rows of its table. */
	label?: string
	/**
	 * The rows that the checkbox stands for, such as the rows of a group.
	 * Without it, the checkbox stands for every row that passes the filters.
	 */
	ids?: readonly string[]
}>()

const { controller, view, selected, messages, label: table } = useDataTable()

const rows = computed(() => props.ids ?? view.value?.selectable ?? [])

// The checkbox of all rows selects the rows of every page, and child rows that
// are closed. Its name says how many, so nobody takes it for the rows in view.
const name = computed(
	() =>
		props.label ?? messages.value.selectAllRows({ count: rows.value.length, table: table.value }),
)

const checked = computed<boolean | 'indeterminate'>(() => {
	let count = 0
	for (const id of rows.value) if (selected.value.has(id)) count++
	if (count === 0) return false
	return count === rows.value.length ? true : 'indeterminate'
})

function change(next: boolean) {
	// Rows that a filter hides keep their selection, in both directions.
	if (!next) controller.deselectRows(rows.value)
	else if (props.ids) controller.selectRows(props.ids)
	else controller.selectAll()
}
</script>

		:disabled="rows.length === 0"
		:label="name"
		@change="change"

export type DataTableMessages = TableMessages & DataTableControlMessages

const named = (text: string, table: string) => (table ? `${text}, ${table}` : text)
const count = (number: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) =>
	`${number} ${number === 1 ? one : many}`

/**
 * The name of a control that shows a text: that text and the name of the
 * table. A caller who translates the text alone gets the name with it, and
 * a caller who gives the name too gets that name.
 */
type NameKey =
	| 'searchLabel'
	| 'filtersLabel'
	| 'filtersTitleLabel'
	| 'columnsLabel'
	| 'exportLabel'
	| 'pageLink'

function namesOf(
	texts: Pick<
		DataTableControlMessages,
		'search' | 'filters' | 'filtersTitle' | 'columns' | 'exportData' | 'pageNumber'
	>,
): Pick<DataTableControlMessages, NameKey> {
	return {
		searchLabel: ({ table }) => named(texts.search(), table),
		filtersLabel: ({ count: set, table }) => named(texts.filters({ count: set }), table),
		filtersTitleLabel: ({ table }) => named(texts.filtersTitle(), table),
		columnsLabel: ({ table }) => named(texts.columns(), table),
		exportLabel: ({ table }) => named(texts.exportData(), table),
		pageLink: ({ page, table }) => named(texts.pageNumber({ page }), table),
	}
}

const controlTexts: Omit<DataTableControlMessages, NameKey> = {
	search: () => 'Search',
	clearSearch: () => 'Clear search',
	filters: ({ count: set }) =>
		set === 0 ? 'Filters' : set === 1 ? '1 filter applied' : `${set} filters applied`,
	filtersTitle: () => 'Column filters',
	clearFilters: () => 'Clear all filters',
	resetFilter: ({ column }) => `Reset filter of ${column}`,
	filterText: ({ column }) => `Filter ${column}`,
	filterAny: () => 'Any value',
	filterValues: ({ column }) => `Values of ${column}`,
	filterMin: ({ column }) => `Lowest ${column}`,
	filterMax: ({ column }) => `Highest ${column}`,
	filterFrom: ({ column }) => `${column} from`,
	filterTo: ({ column }) => `${column} to`,
	min: () => 'Min',
	max: () => 'Max',
	columns: () => 'Columns',
	showAllColumns: () => 'Show all',
	exportData: () => 'Export',
	exportCsv: () => 'Export CSV',
	exportXlsx: () => 'Export Excel',
	exportFailed: () => 'The export failed. Try again.',
	dismiss: () => 'Dismiss',
	pageSizeLabel: ({ table }) => named('Rows per page', table),
	pageSize: ({ size }) => `${size} per page`,
	pagination: ({ table }) => named('Pages', table),
	pageOf: ({ page, pageCount }) => `Page ${page} of ${pageCount}`,
	pageNumber: ({ page }) => `Page ${page}`,
	showingRows: ({ from, to, total, unit, rows }) => {
		if (total === 0) return 'No rows'
		const one = from === to
		if (unit === 'groups') {
			return one
				? `Showing group ${from} of ${count(total, 'group')} (${count(rows, 'row')})`
				: `Showing groups ${from} to ${to} of ${total} (${count(rows, 'row')})`
		}
		if (unit === 'parents') {
			return one
				? `Showing top-level row ${from} of ${total} (${rows} rows with child rows)`
				: `Showing top-level rows ${from} to ${to} of ${total} (${rows} rows with child rows)`
		}
		if (unit === 'mixed') {
			return `Showing ${from} to ${to} of ${total} groups and rows (${count(rows, 'row')})`
		}
		return `Showing ${from} to ${to} of ${count(total, 'row')}`
	},
	selectedRows: ({ count: selected }) => `${count(selected, 'row')} selected`,
	firstPage: ({ table }) => named('First page', table),
	previousPage: ({ table }) => named('Previous page', table),
	nextPage: ({ table }) => named('Next page', table),
	lastPage: ({ table }) => named('Last page', table),
	selectAllRows: ({ count: rows, table }) => named(`Select all ${count(rows, 'row')}`, table),
	selectRow: ({ row }) => `Select row ${row}`,
	selectGroup: ({ group }) => `Select group ${group}`,
	expandAllRows: ({ table }) => named('Expand all rows', table),
	collapseAllRows: ({ table }) => named('Collapse all rows', table),
	expandRowOf: ({ row }) => `Expand row ${row}`,
	collapseRowOf: ({ row }) => `Collapse row ${row}`,
	selectionColumn: () => 'Selection',
	expandColumn: () => 'Details',
	noRowsForSearch: ({ search }) => `No rows match “${search}”.`,
	noRowsForFilters: () => 'No rows match the current filters.',
	rowsFound: ({ total, unit, rows }) => {
		if (rows === 0) return 'No rows found.'
		if (unit === 'groups') return `${count(total, 'group')} with ${count(rows, 'row')} found.`
		if (unit === 'parents') return `${count(rows, 'row')} found, ${total} at the top level.`
		return `${count(rows, 'row')} found.`
	},
	sortedBy: ({ sort }) =>
		sort.length
			? `Sorted by ${sort.map((rule) => `${rule.column}, ${rule.desc ? 'descending' : 'ascending'}`).join(', then by ')}.`
			: 'Not sorted.',
}

export const defaultControlMessages: DataTableControlMessages = {
	...controlTexts,
	...namesOf(controlTexts),
}

/** The English texts of the styled table and of the headless table under it. */
export const defaultDataTableMessages: DataTableMessages = {
	...defaultMessages,
	noRows: () => 'No rows yet.',
	...defaultControlMessages,
}

/** The texts of a table: the defaults, with the texts of the caller over them. */
export function resolveMessages(messages?: Partial<DataTableMessages>): DataTableMessages {
	if (!messages) return defaultDataTableMessages
	const texts = { ...defaultDataTableMessages, ...messages }
	return { ...texts, ...namesOf(texts), ...messages }
}

import type {
	CellEdit,
	CellSlotProps,
	DetailSlotProps,
	EditorSlotProps,
	FootSlotProps,
	GroupSlotProps,
	HeaderSlotProps,
	CellRange,
	ColumnDef,
	ColumnFacetsSource,
	ColumnPinning,
	ColumnVisibility,
	ColumnWidths,
	DataRow,
	ExportOptions,
	FilterState,
	PageState,
	RowPinning,
	SortRule,
	TableChangeDetails,
	TableCommitDetails,
	TableController,
	TableEditDetails,
	TableView,
} from 'ui-sdk-table-vue'
import { inject, type ComputedRef, type InjectionKey, type ShallowRef } from 'vue'
import type { DataTableExportFormat } from './messages'
import type { DataTableMessages } from './messages'

/** A class as Vue takes it: a text, a list or a record of switches. */
export type ClassValue = string | false | null | undefined | ClassValue[] | Record<string, unknown>

/** One entry of a list of the styled table. */
export type DataTableSelectItem = { value: string; label: string }

/** What the styled table reads from the `meta` of a column. */
export type DataTableColumnMeta<Row = unknown> = {
	/** Where the text of the header, the cells and the total sits. A column of numbers defaults to the end. */
	align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
	/** A class for each body cell of the column, or a function that gives one for a cell. */
	class?: ClassValue | ((value: unknown, row: Row) => ClassValue)
	/** A class for the header cell of the column. */
	headerClass?: ClassValue
	/** Whether the text of a cell breaks into lines. Defaults to false. */
	wrap?: boolean
	/** Whether the column has a control in the filter popover. Defaults to true. */
	filterable?: boolean
}

/** A column of the styled table: a column of the headless table, with a typed `meta`. */
export type DataTableColumn<Row = unknown> = Omit<ColumnDef<Row>, 'meta' | 'columns'> & {
	meta?: DataTableColumnMeta<Row>
	columns?: readonly DataTableColumn<Row>[]
}

export type DataTableExport = {
	/** Whether the menu offers a CSV file. Defaults to true. */
	csv?: boolean
	/** Whether the menu offers an Excel file. Defaults to true. */
	xlsx?: boolean
	/** The name of the file, without its ending. Defaults to `export`. */
	filename?: string | (() => string)
	/** Which rows and columns the file holds. Defaults to the rows that pass the filters and the columns in view. */
	options?: ExportOptions
}

export interface DataTableProps<Row> {
	rows?: readonly Row[]
	columns?: readonly DataTableColumn<Row>[]
	/** The name of the table, for assistive technology and for an agent. */
	label?: string

	/** Shows a search field over the table. The text is `filter.search`. */
	search?: boolean
	/** Shows a button over the table that opens a filter for each column in view. */
	columnFilters?: boolean
	/** Shows a menu over the table that shows and hides columns. */
	columnMenu?: boolean
	/**
	 * Shows the pages under the table. Without `page` and `defaultPage`, the
	 * table starts on its first page with the first of `pageSizes`.
	 */
	pagination?: boolean
	/** The page sizes that a person can choose. Defaults to 10, 25, 50 and 100. */
	pageSizes?: readonly number[]
	/** Shows a menu over the table that writes a CSV or an Excel file. */
	export?: boolean | DataTableExport
	/** `full` (the default) fills the place the table has. `auto` is as wide as the columns need. */
	width?: 'full' | 'auto'
	/**
	 * What scrolls the rows. `self` (the default): the frame around the table
	 * scrolls, once `wrapperClass` gives it a height. `page`: the frame never
	 * scrolls, so sticky rows stay at the edge of the page or of a scroll box
	 * around the table.
	 */
	scroll?: 'self' | 'page'
	/** How many skeleton rows show while `loading` is set and the table has no rows. Defaults to 3. */
	skeletonRows?: number
	/** Texts of the controls and of the table, in another language or with other words. */
	messages?: Partial<DataTableMessages>

	/** A class for the frame around the table, which has the border and scrolls. */
	wrapperClass?: ClassValue
	/** A class for the `table` element. */
	tableClass?: ClassValue
	/** A class for each header cell. */
	headerClass?: ClassValue
	/** A class for each row of the body, or a function that gives one for a data row. */
	rowClass?: ClassValue | ((row: Row, index: number) => ClassValue)
	/** A class for each body cell. */
	cellClass?: ClassValue

	getRowId?: (row: Row, index: number, parent: DataRow<Row> | null) => string | number
	getChildren?: (row: Row) => readonly Row[] | undefined
	locale?: string
	searchMode?: 'contains' | 'fuzzy'
	fuzzyThreshold?: number
	sortChildren?: boolean
	canGroup?: (row: Row) => boolean
	/** Row selection, with a checkbox column. */
	selection?: 'single' | 'multiple'
	canSelect?: (row: Row) => boolean
	resizable?: boolean
	reorderable?: boolean
	columnMinWidth?: number
	columnMaxWidth?: number
	controller?: TableController
	rowWindow?: boolean
	rowHeight?: number
	estimatedRowHeight?: number
	overscan?: number
	stickyHeader?: boolean
	stickyFooter?: boolean
	/** Which rows have a detail row, which the `detail` slot fills. */
	hasDetail?: (row: Row) => boolean
	editable?: boolean
	cellSelection?: boolean
	manualSort?: boolean
	manualFilter?: boolean
	/**
	 * The choices of the filter controls as the owner of the rows knows them,
	 * by column id: the values of a list, the lowest and highest number, the
	 * first and last date. With `manualFilter`, the rows of the table hold
	 * only what passes the filter, so give the facets of every row here.
	 */
	facets?: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnFacetsSource>>
	manualPage?: boolean
	rowCount?: number
	loading?: boolean

	sort?: readonly SortRule[]
	defaultSort?: readonly SortRule[]
	filter?: FilterState
	defaultFilter?: FilterState
	groupBy?: readonly string[]
	defaultGroupBy?: readonly string[]
	page?: PageState
	defaultPage?: PageState
	expanded?: readonly string[]
	/**
	 * The ids of the rows and groups that start open. `'all'` opens every
	 * group and every row with child rows that the table has when it mounts.
	 */
	defaultExpanded?: readonly string[] | 'all'
	selected?: string[]
	defaultSelected?: string[]
	columnVisibility?: ColumnVisibility
	defaultColumnVisibility?: ColumnVisibility
	columnOrder?: readonly string[]
	defaultColumnOrder?: readonly string[]
	columnWidths?: ColumnWidths
	defaultColumnWidths?: ColumnWidths
	columnPinning?: ColumnPinning
	defaultColumnPinning?: ColumnPinning
	rowPinning?: RowPinning
	defaultRowPinning?: RowPinning
	cellRange?: CellRange | null
	defaultCellRange?: CellRange | null
}

export type DataTableEmits<Row = unknown> = {
	'update:sort': [value: readonly SortRule[]]
	'update:filter': [value: FilterState]
	'update:groupBy': [value: readonly string[]]
	'update:page': [value: PageState | undefined]
	'update:expanded': [value: readonly string[]]
	'update:selected': [value: string[]]
	'update:columnVisibility': [value: ColumnVisibility]
	'update:columnOrder': [value: readonly string[]]
	'update:columnWidths': [value: ColumnWidths]
	'update:columnPinning': [value: ColumnPinning]
	'update:rowPinning': [value: RowPinning]
	'update:cellRange': [value: CellRange | null]
	sortChange: [value: readonly SortRule[], details: TableChangeDetails]
	filterChange: [value: FilterState, details: TableChangeDetails]
	groupByChange: [value: readonly string[], details: TableChangeDetails]
	pageChange: [value: PageState | undefined, details: TableChangeDetails]
	expandedChange: [value: readonly string[], details: TableChangeDetails]
	selectedChange: [value: string[], details: TableChangeDetails]
	columnVisibilityChange: [value: ColumnVisibility, details: TableChangeDetails]
	columnOrderChange: [value: readonly string[], details: TableChangeDetails]
	columnWidthsChange: [value: ColumnWidths, details: TableChangeDetails]
	columnWidthsCommit: [value: ColumnWidths, details: TableCommitDetails]
	columnPinningChange: [value: ColumnPinning, details: TableChangeDetails]
	rowPinningChange: [value: RowPinning, details: TableChangeDetails]
	cellRangeChange: [value: CellRange | null, details: TableChangeDetails]
	cellRangeCommit: [value: CellRange | null, details: TableCommitDetails]
	cellEdit: [edits: readonly CellEdit<Row>[], details: TableEditDetails]
	/** An export did not give a file: the writers did not load, or the data or the file could not be written. */
	exportError: [error: unknown, details: { format: DataTableExportFormat }]
}

/**
 * The slots of the styled table: the slots of the table under it, and
 * `toolbar`. A slot by column id may be absent, and the type says so: Vue
 * hands a render function the slots as a record that may lack any name.
 */
export type DataTableSlots<Row> = {
	/** One header cell. `header-{column id}` wins over `header`. */
	[name: `header-${string}`]: ((props: HeaderSlotProps<Row>) => unknown) | undefined
	/** One body cell. `col-{column id}` wins over `cell`. */
	[name: `col-${string}`]: ((props: CellSlotProps<Row>) => unknown) | undefined
	/** One total in the footer. `foot-{column id}` wins over `foot`. */
	[name: `foot-${string}`]: ((props: FootSlotProps<Row>) => unknown) | undefined
	/** The editor of one cell. `edit-{column id}` wins over `editor`. */
	[name: `edit-${string}`]: ((props: EditorSlotProps<Row>) => unknown) | undefined
} & {
	header?: (props: HeaderSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	cell?: (props: CellSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	foot?: (props: FootSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	editor?: (props: EditorSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	/** A group row, in place of the button and the totals of the styled table. */
	group?: (props: GroupSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	/** The detail row of a row, for the rows that `hasDetail` names. */
	detail?: (props: DetailSlotProps<Row>) => unknown
	/** Shown in place of the rows when no row passes the filters. */
	empty?: () => unknown
	/** Shown in place of the skeleton rows while `loading` is set and the table has no rows. */
	loading?: () => unknown
	/** The controls of the caller in the toolbar, after the search and the filters. */
	toolbar?: (props: DataTableToolbarSlotProps) => unknown
}

/** What the `toolbar` slot gets: the methods of the table and what it shows now. */
export type DataTableToolbarSlotProps = {
	controller: TableController
	view: TableView | undefined
}

/**
 * What the parts of the styled table share. `view` is what the table shows
 * now; it is `undefined` until the table is on the page. A part that reads it
 * renders again for each change, and the table itself does not.
 */
export type DataTableContext = {
	controller: TableController
	view: Readonly<ShallowRef<TableView | undefined>>
	messages: ComputedRef<DataTableMessages>
	/** The name of the table, or an empty text. */
	label: ComputedRef<string>
	/**
	 * The ids of the selected rows as one set for every part. A table with
	 * groups has a checkbox for each group, and each of them asks which of
	 * its rows are selected: a set of its own for each would be built again
	 * for every checkbox after every change.
	 */
	selected: ComputedRef<ReadonlySet<string>>
	/** How many columns have a filter that asks for something. */
	filterCount: ComputedRef<number>
	/** An export starts: a message about an export that failed before goes away. */
	exportStarted: () => void
	/** An export failed: the table says so, shows a message and sends `exportError`. */
	exportFailed: (error: unknown, format: DataTableExportFormat) => void
}

export const DATA_TABLE_CONTEXT: InjectionKey<DataTableContext> = Symbol('data-table')

/** The table that a part belongs to. A part works only inside a `DataTable`. */
export function useDataTable(): DataTableContext {
	const context = inject(DATA_TABLE_CONTEXT)
	if (!context) throw new Error('A part of the data table must be inside a `DataTable`.')
	return context
}

/** The ids of the two columns that the styled table adds itself. */
export const SELECT_COLUMN = 'data-table-select'
export const EXPAND_COLUMN = 'data-table-expand'

export const isOwnColumn = (id: string) => id === SELECT_COLUMN || id === EXPAND_COLUMN

/** The state keys that `getView` reads. A change of another key, such as the active cell, changes no control. */
export const VIEW_KEYS: readonly string[] = [
	'revision',
	'sort',
	'filter',
	'groupBy',
	'page',
	'expanded',
	'selected',
	'columnVisibility',
	'columnOrder',
	'columnPinning',
	'rowPinning',
]
